newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares surge on optimistic mood.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares surge on optimistic mood.

text.p: Slovenian shares jumped 3.63 percent on Thursday, building on strong gains since the start of tye year, and traders said renewed optimism in the market should continue to drive prices up.
"I think the trend is not just positive but very positive, and I cannot see any reason for declines in the near future," said Rolando Krajnik, a trader at brokerage Perspektiva.
* The 10-share SBI index rose 44.49 points to 1,271.8.
* Drug maker Lek's A issue was the most active share, rising 8.72 percent to 22,950 tolars on volume of 5,575 shares.
* Overall 11 shares rose, eight fell and six were untraded. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
